entries.label: a_sch_ground01_eve01
entries.text: It’s great that the schoolyard’s so big! Even huge\nPokémon have plenty of space to come out!

entries.label: a_sch_ground01_eve02
entries.text: If you stare at Gyarados’s face, it might lower\nyour Attack with Intimidate!

entries.label: a_sch_ground01_eve22
entries.text: I heard that Tropius loves fruit so much it started\ngrowing fruit on its neck!\c\nThat can’t be true, right?!

entries.label: a_sch_ground01_eve24
entries.text: The dishes at the cafeteria all use ingredients\ngrown here!

entries.label: a_sch_ground01_eve25
entries.text: Whether with Pokémon or with gardening, you\nend up asking yourself: What should I raise next?

entries.label: a_sch_ground01_eve26
entries.text: Cyclizar is so glossy and cute! It really helps take\nthe stress of studying away.

entries.label: a_sch_ground01_eve27
entries.text: I’ve started a Cyclizar therapy service. Stare at it\nfor as long as you’d like!

entries.label: a_sch_ground01_eve29
entries.text: I was just running with Mudbray—its stamina is\nsomething else!

entries.label: a_sch_ground01_eve49
entries.text: I’m about to have a Pokémon battle with my\nfriend!

entries.label: a_sch_ground01_eve50
entries.text: Friends know each other’s tricks! When we battle,\nit’s all about anticipating one another’s strategy!

entries.label: a_sch_ground01_ni03
entries.text: I couldn’t sleep, so I thought I’d take a walk\naround the school.

entries.label: a_sch_ground01_ni05
entries.text:
I saw Nemona win 30 Pokémon battles in a row
here at the schoolyard the other day!\c
She definitely deserves that Champion Rank
of hers!

entries.label: a_sch_ground01_ni06
entries.text: Nemona’s the student council president, and a\nChampion, and has top-notch grades...\c\nIs there anything she can’t do?

entries.label: a_sch_ground01_ni09
entries.text: I’m just picturing what it’d be like to battle on\na court so that I don’t get nervous at Gyms!

entries.label: a_sch_ground01_ni16
entries.text: It took a lot of effort to get Magikarp to evolve\ninto Gyarados, let me tell you...

entries.label: a_sch_ground01_ni21
entries.text: Gengar smiles even while it’s sleeping. Isn’t that\njust the most adorable thing ever?

entries.label: a_sch_ground01_ni22
entries.text: I’ve seen a student with a weird hairdo come out\nof the director’s office now and then...
